name: NURE Santa Lucia Nuraghe
summary:
Begin a virtual journey into a Nuragic archaeological site, where ancient stones, forgotten spaces, and hidden stories come together in an immersive VR experience.

Designed as an atmospheric exploration, this experience invites visitors to enter the world of the nuraghe: mysterious stone structures built thousands of years ago, still surrounded by questions about their purpose, their builders, and the rituals that may have taken place around them.
